verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own docs describe campaign email reports with open and click rates and per-link click counts, and e-commerce tracking to measure campaign ROI. Analytics AI is also claimed to explain which campaigns and automations drive revenue, which suggests conversion attribution. Missing for 10: documented unsubscribe metrics in marketing reports, explicit per-automation-step reporting, time-series/trend views of these metrics, detailed conversion-reporting docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
